say:3:1710405002:1.text: I'm surprised you have time to stroll around the palace. Looks like your little investigation is coming along nicely?
say:3:1710405002:1.source_cn: 你既已领受王命，负责调查圣古堂消失一事，如今却有闲暇在...
say:3:1710405002:1.male: I'm surprised you have time to stroll around the palace. Looks like your little investigation is coming along nicely?
say:3:1710405002:1.female: I'm surprised you have time to stroll around the palace. Looks like your little investigation is coming along nicely?

say:4:1710405003:0.text: Or perhaps... you've decided to take Prince Orion up on his offer and work alongside me?
say:4:1710405003:0.source_cn: 还是说……你终于想通了？觉得奥利安王子的提议也不错——...
say:4:1710405003:0.male: Or perhaps... you've decided to take Prince Orion up on his offer and work alongside me?

choice_prompt:5:1710405003.source_cn: 还是说……你终于想通了？觉得奥利安王子的提议也不不错——愿意接受招揽，来做我的同僚？

choice_prompt:5:1710405003.female: Or perhaps... you've decided to take Prince Orion up on his offer and work alongside me?

say:6:1710405004:1.text: Well, nothing truly stays secret in the palace, does it?
say:6:1710405004:1.source_cn: 啊，你应该知道，在宫廷里，没有真正的秘密。
say:6:1710405004:1.male: Well, nothing truly stays secret in the palace, does it?
say:6:1710405004:1.female: Well, nothing truly stays secret in the palace, does it?

say:7:1710405005:1.text: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?
say:7:1710405005:1.source_cn: 我只是单纯地为你感到担忧……如果圣古堂消失一事迟迟没有...
say:7:1710405005:1.male: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?
say:7:1710405005:1.female: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?

choice_prompt:8:1710405005.text: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?
choice_prompt:8:1710405005.source_cn: 我只是单纯地为你感到担忧……如果圣古堂消失一事迟迟没有进展，王后和王子还会如此信任于你吗？
choice_prompt:8:1710405005.male: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?
choice_prompt:8:1710405005.female: I can't help worrying about you... If your investigation goes nowhere, will the Queen and the Prince still place their trust in you?

say:9:1710405011:1.text: You see, I came across some of the nobles on my way here. They claimed they had no idea how they had entered or left the Hall of Ancients.
say:9:1710405011:1.source_cn: 来王宫的路上，我见到了几位大人，他们声称在不知情的情况...
say:9:1710405011:1.male: You see, I came across some of the nobles on my way here. They claimed they had no idea how they had entered or left the Hall of Ancients.
say:9:1710405011:1.female: You see, I came across some of the nobles on my way here. They claimed they had no idea how they had entered or left the Hall of Ancients.

say:10:1710405012:1.text: If I were you, I'd just sit back and wait. Princess Peggy and Cassadee might very well return in one piece without you lifting a finger.
say:10:1710405012:1.source_cn: 既然如此，怎么不等等看呢？说不定下一秒，根本不需要你这...
say:10:1710405012:1.male: If I were you, I'd just sit back and wait. Princess Peggy and Cassadee might very well return in one piece without you lifting a finger.
say:10:1710405012:1.female: If I were you, I'd just sit back and wait. Princess Peggy and Cassadee might very well return in one piece without you lifting a finger.

say:11:1710405013:1.text: Makes your life a little easier, doesn't it?
say:11:1710405013:1.source_cn: 这样也能让你轻松一些，不是吗？
say:11:1710405013:1.male: Makes your life a little easier, doesn't it?
say:11:1710405013:1.female: Makes your life a little easier, doesn't it?

say:13:1710405014:0.text: Magister Merlin, the Queen requests your immediate presence!
say:13:1710405014:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，王后陛下宣您即刻觐见！
say:13:1710405014:0.male: Magister Merlin, the Queen requests your immediate presence!
say:13:1710405014:0.female: Magister Merlin, the Queen requests your immediate presence!

say:14:1710405015:1.text: Tsk... such dreadful timing. I shall not keep you any longer, then.
say:14:1710405015:1.source_cn: 啧……看来时机不巧，那我就不耽误你与王后陛下的重要会晤了。
say:14:1710405015:1.male: Tsk... such dreadful timing. I shall not keep you any longer, then.
say:14:1710405015:1.female: Tsk... such dreadful timing. I shall not keep you any longer, then.

say:16:1710405017:0.text: I hope you bear good news for the Queen.
say:16:1710405017:0.source_cn: 希望你能带给王后陛下……她想听的消息。
say:16:1710405017:0.male: I hope you bear good news for the Queen.
say:16:1710405017:0.female: I hope you bear good news for the Queen.

say:18:1710405006:1.text: Fair enough. After all, we're just old acquaintances, not quite friends.
say:18:1710405006:1.source_cn: 有道理，毕竟我们只是故人，甚至称不上是“故友”。
say:18:1710405006:1.male: Fair enough. After all, we're just old acquaintances, not quite friends.
say:18:1710405006:1.female: Fair enough. After all, we're just old acquaintances, not quite friends.

say:19:1710405007:1.text: I do miss our student days, though. Shame there's little I can do to assist you now.
say:19:1710405007:1.source_cn: 虽然怀念那段共同求学的时光，但看着眼前的你如此迷茫焦灼...
say:19:1710405007:1.male: I do miss our student days, though. Shame there's little I can do to assist you now.
say:19:1710405007:1.female: I do miss our student days, though. Shame there's little I can do to assist you now.

say:20:1710405008:1.text: Indeed, I'm in no position to pry. After all, the Queen and the Prince trust you more than me.
say:20:1710405008:1.source_cn: 看来是我僭越了。比起身为宫廷魔法师的我，王后和王子更为...
say:20:1710405008:1.male: Indeed, I'm in no position to pry. After all, the Queen and the Prince trust you more than me.
say:20:1710405008:1.female: Indeed, I'm in no position to pry. After all, the Queen and the Prince trust you more than me.

say:21:1710405009:1.text: By the way... is Cassadee, my subordinate, also in the Hall? I hear you two were rather close during the selection exam.
say:21:1710405009:1.source_cn: 不过……听说我的那位下属，科丝蒂也在里面？她在莱希拉姆...
say:21:1710405009:1.male: By the way... is Cassadee, my subordinate, also in the Hall? I hear you two were rather close during the selection exam.
say:21:1710405009:1.female: By the way... is Cassadee, my subordinate, also in the Hall? I hear you two were rather close during the selection exam.

say:22:1710405010:1.text: Now, it's all on you to save her and the Princess... I hope the pressure isn't crushing you.
say:22:1710405010:1.source_cn: 如今两条人命全系于你一人之身……这沉甸甸的压力，没把你...
say:22:1710405010:1.male: Now, it's all on you to save her and the Princess... I hope the pressure isn't crushing you.
say:22:1710405010:1.female: Now, it's all on you to save her and the Princess... I hope the pressure isn't crushing you.

choice:5:2:3.text: I answer to no one but the Queen.
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 事关机密，我只向王后汇报
choice:5:2:3.male: I answer to no one but the Queen.
choice:5:2:3.female: I answer to no one but the Queen.

choice:2:0:1.text: ... Why are you being so polite?
choice:2:0:1.male: ... Why are you being so polite?
choice:2:0:1.female: ... Why are you being so polite?

choice:2:1:2.text: Save it, we just met recently.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 省省吧，我们才见过不久
choice:2:1:2.male: Save it, we just met recently.
choice:2:1:2.female: Save it, we just met recently.
